description: This file defines a React functional component called PreferencesViewWrapper, which manages the display and interaction of a preferences modal within a web application. It uses React hooks, MobX for state management, and integrates commands for opening preferences.

methods.name: PreferencesViewWrapper
methods.description: A React functional component that wraps the preferences view within a modal overlay. It sets up a command handler for opening preferences and passes necessary props to the PreferencesView component.
